content.markdown: Ali Chuk is a populated place and census designated place in Pima County, Arizona, United States. Its population was 161 as of the 2010 census, and it has a land area of 1.44 sq mi (3.7 km2). It has an estimated elevation of 1,762 feet (537 m) above sea level. It is located adjacent to the border with Mexico. It is not to be confused with another village on the reservation, Ali Chukson.
